description: Update a draft — set draft_planned_for to null to clear the planned date. Drafts never publish. Existing API keys need the new `drafts:write` scope added to gain draft access; no implicit grant occurs.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

draft_planned_for.description: ISO 8601 date/time for calendar placement (null clears it).

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in. Do not ask the user for this UUID — call aidelly_list_workspaces and use the `id` of the matching workspace. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_update_draft
